Q6113.reason: Arson requires malice, and inadvertently leaving the stove on constitutes negligence rather than intentional or reckless conduct.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle consists of systole, when the heart contracts, and diastole, when it relaxes.

Q8294.reason: Hydrogen bonding creates an open crystalline structure in ice, making it less dense than liquid water, so increased pressure favors melting.
